study: Saved finger-end contacts versus detailed visual triangle surfaces

xml_contact_provenance.interpretation: Detailed finger_vis is a noncolliding display mesh in this XML; actual collision uses finger plus separate high-friction pad boxes. Visual-surface agreement is a diagnostic model-consistency check, not verified physical material calibration.

thresholds_scope: 1um is the existing intended-contact tolerance;0.1mm and0.25mm are diagnostic reporting thresholds, never tuned acceptance limits
validity_scope: Distances do not modify modeled validity and do not establish physical contact material or pickup/assembly success
